title: Brian Balfour on Reforge Growth Frameworks, Market-Product Fit, and Retention Loops
content:
Lenny Rachitsky: Welcome to Lenny's Podcast. Today my guest is Brian Balfour, founder and CEO of Reforge and former VP of Growth at HubSpot.

Brian Balfour: Thanks Lenny, glad to be here.

Lenny Rachitsky: What is the core difference between growth funnels and growth loops?

Brian Balfour: Funnels are linear models—traffic enters at the top, drops off at each stage, and exits at the bottom. To sustain growth with a funnel, you must constantly pour more inputs in. Growth loops, on the other hand, are closed systems where the output of one cycle feeds directly into the input of the next cycle. Whether it is a viral referral loop, a content SEO loop, or a paid marketing reinvestment loop, compounding growth comes from loops, not funnels.

Lenny Rachitsky: Can you explain your Four Fits framework?

Brian Balfour: Product-Market Fit alone is insufficient. You need Four Fits working together: Market-Product Fit, Product-Channel Fit, Channel-Model Fit, and Model-Market Fit. You cannot define your product in isolation from how it will be distributed or how it will be monetized. Changes to your model immediately impact channel viability.
